identification: Four children's/illustrated books: (1) The Classic Tales of Beatrix Potter, Complete Adventures of Peter Rabbit and Friends, modern Warne omnibus; (2) Carroll, Through the Looking-Glass, modern jacketed hardback with coloured Tenniel; (3) The Annotated Alice (Gardner/Tenniel) in the grey jacket with green ribbon and two compass roses, the design used by both the 1960 Clarkson N. Potter edition and the later Bramhall House reprints; (4) Milne, Winnie the Pooh: The Complete Collection of Stories and Poems, modern omnibus.
